why: Hakodate soul food for under ¥700: a hot dinner or car lunch before the drive to Onuma and Niseko.
cost: ¥680 (small, 3 pork skewers, tax incl., menu of July 2026) vs about ¥1,500+ for a sit-down dinner in the Bay Area
winterNote: Made to order: allow 10 min, or phone 1 h before. Five flavours; タレ (sauce) is the most popular. Prices can change; confirm in the shop.

places.ja: ハセガワストア ベイエリア店
ラッキーピエロ ベイエリア本店

experience.hook: A hot box of charcoal-grilled pork skewers for ¥680.
moments: Walk to Hasegawa Store Bay Area (5 min from Suehirocho tram stop).
Fill in the order slip: やきとり弁当（小）, flavour タレ.
Wait for your number, then eat in the small eating corner or in the car.
Cross the street to Lucky Pierrot for a Chinese Chicken Burger if you want more.
experience.tip: Pull the skewers out with the lid held down: that is how locals eat it.

title: ¥600 Yoshida udon after Chureito
titleJa: 元祖 みうらうどん（吉田のうどん）
summary: Yoshida udon is the hard, chewy local noodle of Fujiyoshida, sold in simple shops for a few hundred yen. Miura Udon, near Shimoyoshida Station below the Chureito Pagoda, sells niku (beef) udon for ¥600.
why: A warm local meal after a cold sunrise shoot, much cheaper than a tourist hoto set at the lake.
cost: ¥600 (niku udon, medium) vs about ¥1,500 for a hoto set at Kawaguchiko shops (typical price, not checked for 2027)
winterNote: Open 10:00–14:00, closed Wednesday. Jan 23, 2027 is a Saturday, so it is open. Many Yoshida udon shops close by 14:00. Position is block-level (下吉田1丁目).

experience.hook: Hard, chewy Fuji noodles in miso-soy soup for ¥600.
moments: After sunrise at the Chureito Pagoda, rest in the car or a cafe until 10:00.
Drive or walk 10 min to Miura Udon in Shimoyoshida.
Order 肉うどん (niku udon), medium.
Add the red chilli paste 'suridane' on the table.
experience.tip: Pay cash; small udon shops often do not take cards.

title: Standing sushi in Shinjuku
titleJa: 寿司 魚がし日本一 新宿西口店（立喰）
summary: Uogashi Nihon-ichi is a standing sushi bar: a chef makes each piece in front of you. Pieces start at ¥75 (ordered two at a time), and a set of nigiri is ¥1,400.
why: Counter sushi made by hand, at kaitenzushi prices, 10 min from Hotel Gracery.
cost: about ¥1,400–2,000 per person vs ¥3,500+ for a sit-down nigiri set (e.g. ¥3,500 特選握り at an airport sushi counter)
winterNote: Mon–Fri 11:00–23:00, Sat 11:00–22:00, Sun/holiday 11:00–21:30. No reservations (standing shop). Prices from the Tabelog menu; check in the shop.

experience.hook: Stand at the counter and eat nigiri the moment the chef puts it down.
moments: Walk to the west exit side of Shinjuku Station (Nishi-Shinjuku 1-12-12).
Stand at a free space at the counter and order by the menu board, two pieces per order.
Start with the ¥75 and ¥120 fish, then add one or two top pieces.
Pay and leave in 20–30 min: that is normal here.
experience.tip: Go at lunch or after 21:00 when the counter is less full.

title: Senbero drinks at Omoide Yokocho
titleJa: 立呑み晩杯屋 新宿思い出横丁店 / ゴールデン街
summary: Senbero means 'drunk for ¥1,000'. Banpaiya in Omoide Yokocho sells stew and fried liver for ¥130 and drinks from ¥290, from 7:00 to 23:30. In Golden Gai, choose bars with no seat charge.
why: See Shinjuku's old alley bars for about ¥1,000 each, not ¥5,000+.
cost: about ¥1,000 per person (2 drinks + 2 small plates) vs a Golden Gai bill with charge that can reach ¥5,000 for 2 drinks
winterNote: Banpaiya: 7:00–23:30 every day, cash only, about 40 people. Golden Gai: many bars charge ¥500–2,000 seat fee; Bar Araku waives its ¥700 charge for foreign tourists; 4C's Bar Rosso has happy hour to 19:00 with no charge (from their X account, check).

experience.hook: Two drinks and two plates in a smoky Showa alley for about ¥1,000.
moments: Walk 3 min from Shinjuku west exit into Omoide Yokocho.
At Banpaiya, order 煮込み (¥130) and レバフライ (¥130) with a ¥290 green-tea highball.
Walk 10 min east to Golden Gai and look for signs 'No charge' / チャージなし.
Ask the price before you sit if there is no price on the door.
experience.tip: Pay cash and keep each stop to 1–2 drinks: that is how senbero works.

title: Half-price depachika dinner
titleJa: 伊勢丹新宿店 デパ地下（閉店前の値引き）
summary: Department-store food halls cut prices on sushi, bento and deli food before they close at 20:00. At Isetan Shinjuku, 20–30% stickers start near 19:00 and 50% stickers near 19:30.
why: Top-quality sushi and bento for a hotel-room dinner at about half price, 8 min walk from Hotel Gracery.
cost: about ¥1,000–1,500 per person vs ¥2,000–3,000 at full price
winterNote: Closes 20:00; best time 19:15–19:50. What is cut and how much changes each day. High-end brand counters often do not cut prices. Supermarkets start earlier (18:00–19:00).

experience.hook: Isetan sushi and bento at half price, eaten in your hotel room.
moments: Come to the Isetan Shinjuku main building B1 at about 19:15.
Walk the sushi, bento and deli counters and look for yellow and red stickers.
Buy at the 半額 (50% off) sticker near 19:30–19:50.
Walk 8 min back to Hotel Gracery and eat in the room.
experience.tip: Sushi and sashimi get cut last; wait until 19:40 if you want them.

title: Uobei touch-screen sushi Shibuya
titleJa: 魚べい 渋谷道玄坂店
summary: Uobei is a sushi chain where you order on a screen and the plates come to your seat on a fast rail. Plates start at about ¥150 including tax.
why: Cheap and fun sushi 5 min from Shibuya Sky, good for a quick dinner before or after the view.
cost: about ¥1,500–2,000 per person (10–12 plates) vs ¥3,500+ for a sushi-counter set
winterNote: Prices from Tabelog (from ¥150). There is often a line at dinner; go before 18:00.

experience.hook: Sushi flies to your seat on a rail, from ¥150 a plate.
moments: Walk up Dogenzaka from Shibuya Station.
Take a ticket at the machine and wait for your seat number.
Order on the screen in English, three plates at a time.
Push the plates into the slot at the end, then pay at the register.
experience.tip: Try the ¥230 kitsune udon or ramen for a warm filler.

title: Local kaitenzushi: Toriton and Hanamaru
titleJa: 回転寿し トリトン / 回転寿司 根室花まる
summary: Toriton and Nemuro Hanamaru are the conveyor sushi chains Hokkaido people rate highest. With the car you can go to Toriton in Asahikawa (Kyokushin) and Sapporo (Kita-8 Kosei); Hanamaru is inside Sapporo Station (Stellar Place 6F).
why: Hokkaido fish like a sushi bar, for about ¥3,500 per person, not ¥8,000+.
cost: about ¥3,000–3,600 per person (one review: 20 plates for 2 = ¥7,200 at Toriton) vs ¥3,500 for only 9 pieces at a counter sushi shop, and ¥8,000+ for omakase
winterNote: Toriton Kyokushin (Asahikawa) 11:00–22:00, may close early when busy; car park. Hanamaru Stellar Place 11:00–22:00; tickets from 10:00, waits of 2–3 h at dinner; scan the QR code and get a LINE/e-mail call. No reservations at either. Tokyo option: Nemuro Hanamaru KITTE Marunouchi (5F), line up by 10:50.

places.ja: 回転寿し トリトン 旭神店
回転寿し トリトン 北8条光星店
根室花まる JRタワーステラプレイス店
根室花まる KITTE丸の内店

experience.hook: Hokkaido scallop, salmon roe and sea urchin from a conveyor belt at local prices.
moments: Day 11: drive to Toriton Kyokushin in Asahikawa for dinner; park free at the shop.
Order the local fish by shouting to the chef or on the tablet; look at the plate colour for price.
Day 13: on the way into Sapporo, stop at Toriton Kita-8 Kosei (car park), not the crowded station shop.
Day 14: if you want Hanamaru, take a ticket at Stellar Place at 10:00 and scan the QR code to wait outside.
experience.tip: Go at 16:00–17:00 on a weekday: the lines at 18:00–20:00 are long.

title: Seicomart Hot Chef meals
titleJa: セイコーマート ホットシェフ
summary: Seicomart is Hokkaido's own konbini. Its Hot Chef counter cooks katsudon, fried chicken and big onigiri in the shop. A katsudon is ¥669 (Feb 2026).
why: A hot, filling meal for under ¥700 near the ski hill, on road trips and at the airport, instead of ski-resort prices.
cost: ¥669 katsudon vs about ¥2,000+ for lunch at Niseko Hirafu ski restaurants (typical, check)
winterNote: Hot Chef is not in every Seicomart and some items sell out by evening. Seicomart shops are on almost all roads you drive (Kutchan town has several). Price rose from ¥637 to ¥669 in one year; expect a little more in 2027.

places.ja: セイコーマート 倶知安
セイコーマート ニセコひらふ

experience.hook: A hot katsudon from a konbini, cooked in the shop, for ¥669.
moments: Look for the orange Seicomart sign with a HOT CHEF counter.
Take the katsudon, butadon or fried chicken from the warm shelf.
Ask them to warm it (温めてください) if it is not warm.
Eat in the car before the ski lift or on the drive to Otaru.
experience.tip: Buy Seicomart's own-brand drinks and snacks too: they are cheaper than other konbini.

title: Local diner in Kutchan
titleJa: 山本食堂（倶知安）
summary: Yamamoto Shokudo is an old family diner in central Kutchan, near Hotel 3M. It serves katsu curry, tempura soba and donburi for about ¥800–1,100, all day with no break.
why: Eat where Kutchan locals eat, for half the price of Hirafu ski-village restaurants.
cost: ¥800–1,100 per dish (katsu curry ¥910) vs about ¥2,000+ for a main at Hirafu restaurants (typical, check)
winterNote: Mon–Fri 11:00–19:30, Sat/Sun/holidays 11:00–19:00, irregular closed days (phone before). Jan 27–28, 2027 are Wednesday and Thursday. Last order is early: go before 19:00. Position is block-level (Kita-1 Higashi-2).

experience.hook: Hot katsu curry for ¥910 in a Showa-era diner full of locals.
moments: After skiing, drive back to Kutchan town (about 15 min from Hirafu).
Park and walk to Yamamoto Shokudo at Kita-1 Higashi-2.
Order katsu curry or the mini tempura-don + soba set.
Walk to the Seicomart on the same block for breakfast supplies.
experience.tip: Go at about 17:30: the diner closes at 19:00–19:30.

title: Asahikawa ramen at Hachiya
titleJa: ラーメンの蜂屋 五条創業店
summary: Hachiya (since 1947) makes Asahikawa shoyu ramen with a pork-and-fish soup and burnt lard on top. A bowl starts at ¥930; it is an 8-minute walk from Dormy Inn Asahikawa.
why: A famous local ramen for under ¥1,000, near your hotel on the Asahikawa night.
cost: from ¥930 per bowl vs about ¥1,500+ for a sit-down dinner
winterNote: 10:30–19:50. The official site says open every day; the tourism site says closed Thursday: phone 0166-22-3343. Jan 29 is Friday, Jan 30 Saturday. You can ask for less burnt lard (少なめ).

experience.hook: Smoky burnt-lard shoyu ramen, 8 min on foot from your hotel.
moments: Walk from Dormy Inn Asahikawa to 5-jo 7-chome.
Order しょうゆラーメン; say ラード少なめ if you want it lighter.
Finish before 19:50 last service.
Back at the hotel, still take the free yonaki soba if you have room.
experience.tip: Go at lunch on Jan 30 if you arrive late on Jan 29.

title: Free sweets tastings in Otaru
titleJa: 小樽 堺町通り 試食（ルタオ本店・北菓楼 小樽本館）
summary: On Sakaimachi street, LeTAO's main shop gives free samples of its Double Fromage cheesecake, and Kitakaro next door gives free samples of okaki rice crackers and baumkuchen.
why: Taste the famous Hokkaido sweets free before you choose one box of gifts.
cost: ¥0 for samples vs about ¥860+ for a LeTAO cafe cake set
winterNote: LeTAO main shop 9:00–18:00 (can change by season); Kitakaro Otaru 10:00–18:00. Samples depend on the day and how busy the shop is. Sakaimachi street is icy in January: wear shoes with grip.

places.ja: 小樽洋菓子舗ルタオ本店

experience.hook: Free cheesecake and baumkuchen samples along a snowy old street.
moments: Park near Minami-Otaru and walk to the Merchen crossroads.
Taste Double Fromage at LeTAO main shop (1F).
Walk next door to Kitakaro for okaki and baumkuchen samples.
Buy one box of your favourite as a gift.
experience.tip: Go before 11:00: fewer tour buses and more samples out.

title: New tax-free refund at departure
titleJa: 免税 リファンド方式（出国時に返金）
summary: From 1 Nov 2026 shops charge the full price with 10% tax, and you get the tax back after a customs check at the airport. Show your passport at each shop, keep items unopened, and scan your passport at the customs kiosk before you check in your bags.
why: Both of you shop in Tokyo and Hokkaido; if you do not know the new steps you lose the 10% at the airport.
duration: 10 min per shop, 5–15 min at the airport
cost: 10% back on ¥5,000+ (before tax) per shop per day, vs 0% if you miss the customs check
winterNote: Rule starts 1 Nov 2026, so it applies to the whole trip. Customs check must be BEFORE bag drop at Narita (Pegasis) and New Chitose (Aoki); both airports also accept Visit Japan Web. Leave Japan within 90 days of purchase. If one item of a receipt is missing or opened, the whole receipt gets no refund. Refund goes to card, app or cash, depending on the shop; some shops may keep a small fee.

places.ja: 新千歳空港 国際線ターミナル

experience.hook: Pay full price now, get 10% back at the airport, if you keep every item.
moments: Show your passport at the till and choose how you want the refund (card, app or cash).
Keep all items of each tax-free receipt together and unopened until you fly.
At the airport, go to the customs kiosk BEFORE the airline counter and scan your passport.
If the screen is green, check in; if red, show the items to the customs officer.
Wait for the refund on your card or app; the time depends on the shop.
experience.tip: Arrive 30 min earlier than normal on Feb 2; a red result after bag drop means no refund.

title: Free Tokyo view from City Hall
titleJa: 東京都庁 展望室（無料）
summary: Take the lift to the free 202 m observatory of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, 10 minutes' walk from your hotel. After dark, watch the free projection mapping show on the building wall.
why: On a clear winter day you see Mt Fuji and Skytree for ¥0, next to your Shinjuku hotel.
cost: Free vs Shibuya Sky ¥2,700–3,400 web (¥3,000–3,700 at the counter)
winterNote: South deck 9:30–21:30, closed 1st and 3rd Tuesday (so closed on Tue 19 Jan 2027); North deck 9:30–17:00, closed 2nd and 4th Monday. Fuji is clearest on winter mornings. Projection mapping 'TOKYO Night & Light' runs every 30 min about 18:30–21:30 (Sept 2026 schedule). If you keep Shibuya Sky, buy online: it saves ¥300 each.
photoQuery: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building observatory Mount Fuji

experience.hook: See Fuji from 202 m for free, 10 minutes from your bed.
moments: Walk to the main building and take the observatory lift on the 1st floor.
Look west for Mt Fuji and northeast for Skytree.
Play the free 'Memories Piano' if the South deck is open.
Come back after dark for the projection show on the tower wall.
experience.tip: Go at 9:30 on Jan 20 or Jan 23: winter air is often clearest in the morning.

title: Sento and hotel onsen, not spas
titleJa: 銭湯・ドーミーイン大浴場
summary: A neighbourhood sento in Tokyo costs ¥600 and in Hokkaido ¥550. Your Dormy Inn hotels in Sendai, Asahikawa and Sapporo have their own hot baths, free for guests.
why: You want many onsen moments; most can cost ¥0–600 instead of big spa prices.
cost: ¥600 Tokyo sento / ¥550 Hokkaido sento / ¥0 Dormy Inn bath, vs large spa complexes that cost several times more
winterNote: Tokyo price is ¥600 from 1 Aug 2026; Hokkaido ¥550 from 1 Oct 2026. Bring a small towel and soap or buy them at the counter. Dormy Inn baths are open late and early morning.

experience.hook: Soak like a local under a Mt Fuji wall painting for ¥600.
moments: Find the nearest sento on the Tokyo Sento map (1010.or.jp).
Pay ¥600 at the counter and rent a towel if needed.
Wash at a stool, then soak in the hot tub under the painted mural.
In the Dormy Inn hotels, use the big hotel bath before bed, free for guests.
experience.tip: Bring a small towel and coins; many sento rent towels but charge extra.

title: Free footbath at Yunokawa Onsen
titleJa: 湯の川温泉足湯「湯巡り舞台」
summary: Hakodate's Yunokawa Onsen has a free public footbath by the tram stop. Warm your feet in real onsen water before or after the morning market or the night view.
why: A free warm-up in snowy Hakodate on the evening you arrive by Shinkansen.
cost: Free vs ¥500–1,500 for a day onsen
winterNote: Open 9:00–21:00, free. Bring a small towel to dry your feet. On the tram line to Yunokawa Onsen stop.

experience.hook: Hot feet, cold air, free: Hakodate's onsen footbath by the tram.
moments: Ride the tram to Yunokawa Onsen stop.
Take off shoes and socks and sit on the wooden bench.
Put your feet in the hot water while snow falls around you.
Dry your feet with your own towel and walk to dinner.
experience.tip: Go before 21:00 closing and keep a spare pair of warm socks in your bag.

title: Super Hotel Shinjuku instead of Gracery
titleJa: スーパーホテル新宿歌舞伎町（高濃度炭酸泉 演舞の湯）
summary: Stay 4 nights at Super Hotel Shinjuku Kabukicho, 5 min from Gracery. Twin room with a free breakfast buffet (fresh bread) and a carbonated-spring public bath.
why: Same street as Gracery, but the twin room costs about half and breakfast is included. Taiwanese and HK blogs rate it a top value pick in Shinjuku.
cost: Twin, 2 people, with breakfast: Jan 19 ¥16,000, Jan 20 ¥17,600, Jan 21 ¥17,800, Jan 23 (Sat) ¥22,900 = about ¥74,300. Gracery twin on Jalan for the same nights: ¥29,160 + ¥29,160 + ¥30,210 + ¥38,660 = about ¥127,000 (room only).
winterNote: Prices seen on Jalan and Rakuten on 25 Sep 2026 for the real dates. Room is an 'economy twin' with two 90 cm beds, so it is small. The free Super Hotel 'Smart Membership' gives about ¥500 cash back per night when you book on the official site or app (4 nights = about ¥2,000). Kabukicho is noisy at night.

experience.hook: Save about ¥50,000 on 4 Tokyo nights and get breakfast every day.
moments: Open the Super Hotel app or superhotel.co.jp and join Smart Membership (free).
Search 'スーパーホテル新宿歌舞伎町', 2 adults, twin, Jan 19–22 and Jan 23–24 (two bookings, Jan 22 you are in Kawaguchiko).
Compare with Jalan and Rakuten (the Rakuten 'さき楽' 90-day plan is ¥17,800); take the lowest.
At check-in use the machine; the ¥500/night points come back as cash.
experience.tip: Leave big bags at the hotel on Jan 22; ask the front desk to keep them for one night.

title: Onsen ryokan in Shinjuku, same price
titleJa: ONSEN RYOKAN 由縁 新宿
summary: A modern ryokan-style hotel near Shinjuku-gyoemmae with a rooftop open-air bath. Weekday twin rooms cost about the same as a Gracery twin.
why: For the same money as Gracery you get an onsen-style bath every night in central Tokyo, good after long anime and car days.
cost: Twin, room only: ¥30,000 (Rakuten, Wed Jan 20) vs Gracery twin ¥29,160–30,700 (Jalan). Saturday Jan 23: Yuen ¥40,800 vs Gracery ¥38,660.
winterNote: Weeknights only give the value; for Sat Jan 23 keep a cheaper hotel. Breakfast plan adds about ¥4,800 pp. Prices seen 25 Sep 2026 for the real dates.

experience.hook: Same price as Gracery, but you end the day in a rooftop hot bath.
moments: On Rakuten Travel search 'ONSEN RYOKAN 由縁 新宿', 2 adults, twin, Jan 19–22.
Pick the '素泊まり 基本プラン' twin (about ¥30,000).
Get the Rakuten Super SALE coupon first (see the Rakuten entry) to cut 4–10% more.
Book the Saturday night somewhere cheaper, e.g. Super Hotel Shinjuku.
experience.tip: The bath is busiest 21:00–23:00; go before dinner.

title: Route Inn Kawaguchiko cheaper on Jalan
titleJa: ホテルルートイン河口湖（霊水の湯）
summary: Keep the same hotel, but book it on Jalan, Rakuten or the Route Inn site. The twin with free breakfast and onsen is cheaper there than on Expedia.
why: No change to the plan, just a lower price for the same room.
cost: ¥13,900 twin, 2 people, breakfast included (Jalan and Rakuten, Fri Jan 22) vs ¥16,000–22,000 on Expedia.
winterNote: The ¥13,900 room faces away from the lake (no Fuji view). Route Inn official site: free membership gives ¥300 off per stay. If you want a lake-view open-air bath, Ashiwada Hotel (4.6/5 on Jalan) is ¥16,830 twin with breakfast on the 'さき楽60/早期割60' plan (book 60 days ahead, by about Nov 23).

experience.hook: Same Route Inn, ¥2,000–8,000 less, breakfast still free.
moments: Search 'ホテルルートイン河口湖' on Jalan, Fri Jan 22, 2 adults.
Pick 'スタンダードプラン 朝食付' with the 禁煙カジュアルツイン room (¥13,900).
Check route-inn.co.jp with a free member account; it should be ¥300 lower.
Cancel the Expedia booking only after the new one is confirmed.
experience.tip: Ask the breakfast start time at check-in if you go for the Chureito sunrise.

title: JR Inn Hakodate next to station
titleJa: JRイン函館
summary: A 4.6/5 business hotel right beside Hakodate Station with a public bath. Twin room only is about ¥8,000 less than La Vista Hakodate Bay.
why: You leave by car early next day, so a hotel next to the station and rental car shops saves time and money; the morning market is 2 min away for breakfast.
cost: Twin, room only, Tue Jan 26: ¥14,200 (Jalan and Rakuten sale) / ¥14,600 (早期45) vs La Vista Hakodate Bay twin ¥22,356–24,840 room only, ¥29,600–31,234 with breakfast.
winterNote: Early-bird '早期45' needs booking 45 days ahead (by about Dec 12). The famous La Vista breakfast is what you give up; a seafood bowl at Hakodate morning market costs about ¥2,000–3,500 pp.

experience.hook: Save about ¥8,000 and sleep 1 minute from the station and market.
moments: Jalan or Rakuten: 'JRイン函館', Jan 26, 2 adults, twin.
Book the sale plan by Sep 29 or the '早期45' plan by mid-December.
Walk to Hakodate Asaichi at 7:00 for a seafood bowl.
Pick up the rental car near the station and drive to Onuma.
experience.tip: Ask for a high floor on the Hakodate-yama side for a night view.

title: La Vista Hakodate early-bird breakfast
titleJa: ラビスタ函館ベイ 早期割90
summary: If you keep La Vista Hakodate Bay for its famous seafood breakfast, book the sale or the 90-day early-bird plan, which also gives a room on floor 7 or higher and late check-out.
why: Same hotel and breakfast, lower price, better room.
cost: Twin with breakfast: ¥29,600 (Jalan sale, to Sep 29) or ¥31,234 (早期割90) vs about ¥36,000 standard with breakfast; room only ¥22,356 (Rakuten Super SALE 10% off) vs ¥24,840.
winterNote: 早期割90 must be booked 90 days before (by about Oct 28, 2026). Sale plans are prepaid by card.

experience.hook: Keep the ikura breakfast, pay less, sleep higher.
moments: Jalan: 'ラビスタ函館ベイ', Jan 26, 2 adults, twin.
Before Sep 29: take the sale plan with breakfast (¥29,600).
Or before Oct 28: take '【早期割90】朝食付 7階以上確約＆レイトアウト'.
Use the rooftop onsen at night and the free ramen snack.
experience.tip: Go to breakfast at opening time; the ikura bowl queue gets long.

title: Premier Hotel CABIN Asahikawa onsen
titleJa: 天然温泉 プレミアホテル-CABIN-旭川
summary: A business hotel 3 min from Asahikawa Station with a natural hot spring bath and a Finnish sauna. On Fri Jan 29 it costs less than half of Dormy Inn Asahikawa.
why: Dormy Inn Asahikawa is very expensive that Friday; CABIN gives the same onsen-and-sauna night near the station for much less.
cost: Twin, room only: ¥19,008 (決めトク, prepaid, no cancel) / ¥20,064 (flexible) vs Dormy Inn Asahikawa twin ¥42,300–43,000. Save about ¥23,000.
winterNote: Seen 25 Sep 2026 for Fri Jan 29, 2027. The ¥19,008 plan cannot be cancelled; the ¥20,064 plan can. Twin room type is 'おまかせ' (hotel chooses, 18 m² or more). Hong Kong and Taiwan blogs list it as a high-value Asahikawa pick.

experience.hook: Onsen and sauna by the station, about ¥23,000 cheaper than Dormy.
moments: Jalan or Rakuten: 'プレミアホテル-CABIN-旭川', Jan 29, 2 adults, twin.
Pick the flexible plan (¥20,064) until your flights are fixed.
Park the rental car at the hotel parking (ask the price when booking).
Soak in the onsen after the Otaru drive; ramen alley is a short walk.
experience.tip: Ask for a non-smoking twin in the booking note; the cheapest twin is listed as a smoking room.

title: Furano onsen hotel with 2 meals
titleJa: スパ＆ホテルリゾート ふらのラテール
summary: An onsen hotel in Naka-Furano. For the same price as a room-only double at Natulux, you get a 10-mat Japanese room, dinner, breakfast and hot spring baths.
why: More for the same money on a Saturday night in peak ski season, and a quiet onsen night after the zoo and Blue Pond.
cost: ¥39,400 for 2 with dinner + breakfast (エコノミーライト plan, Sat Jan 30) vs Natulux double room only ¥38,380 (早旅90) to ¥42,660. Cheaper option: Furano Hops Hotel (Kami-Furano) 33 m² twin room only ¥20,800, save about ¥17,500.
winterNote: La Terre is about 15 min by car north of Furano town, so you need the car (you have it). Natulux early-bird 90 must be booked by about Nov 1. Seen 25 Sep 2026 for the real date.

experience.hook: Pay Natulux room-only money, get onsen plus dinner and breakfast.
moments: Rakuten or Jalan: 'ふらのラテール', Jan 30, 2 adults.
Choose 'エコノミーライト 1泊2食付' in the 10-mat Japanese room (¥39,400).
Drive from Biei Blue Pond (about 40 min) and arrive before dinner time.
Next morning drive 15 min into Furano, then on to Sapporo.
experience.tip: If you prefer beds, Furano Hops Hotel twin is ¥20,800 and closer to Biei.

title: Route Inn Sapporo Chuo, both nights
titleJa: ホテルルートイン札幌中央
summary: A 4.3/5 business hotel in central Sapporo with a public bath and free breakfast buffet. Twin on Jan 31, then Aoki stays on in a single on Feb 1, so no hotel change.
why: Dormy Inn Premium Sapporo is very expensive that weekend; this saves about ¥26,000 over the two nights and includes breakfast. The hotel also has a free shuttle plan to Sapporo central fish market.
cost: Jan 31 twin with breakfast ¥16,500 + Feb 1 single with breakfast ¥12,850 (Rakuten 早期得割) = ¥29,350 vs Dormy Inn Premium Sapporo twin ¥36,900 + economy single (no shower) ¥18,900 = ¥55,800 room only.
winterNote: 早期得割 needs booking 28 days ahead (by Jan 4). Jalan single is ¥14,300. Route Inn official site gives ¥300 off per stay for free members. Seen 25 Sep 2026 for the real dates.

experience.hook: Two Sapporo nights with breakfast for about half the Dormy price.
moments: Rakuten: 'ホテルルートイン札幌中央', Jan 31, 2 adults, twin, standard plan (¥16,500).
Second booking: Feb 1, 1 adult, single, '早期得割' plan (¥12,850).
Ask at check-in for the free shuttle to the central wholesale market (北のグルメ plan).
Pegasis leaves for New Chitose on Feb 1; Aoki keeps the bags in the same hotel.
experience.tip: Tell the front desk that one person stays a second night, so the key and room move are easy.

title: Vessel Campana: seafood breakfast, less money
titleJa: ベッセルホテルカンパーナすすきの
summary: A 4.7/5 hotel in Susukino with a large bath and sauna, famous for its breakfast buffet where you build your own seafood rice bowl.
why: Chinese-language travel blogs call it the best-value Sapporo hotel for its breakfast; it costs less with breakfast than Dormy Premium without.
cost: Twin with breakfast ¥28,690 (Rakuten Super SALE 5% off), room only ¥24,320 vs Dormy Inn Premium Sapporo twin room only ¥36,900.
winterNote: Sale price only if booked by Oct 1, 09:59 JST; normal twin room only is ¥25,600. Seen 25 Sep 2026 for Sun Jan 31, 2027.

experience.hook: Build your own ikura and salmon bowl at breakfast, and still pay ¥8,000 less.
moments: Before Oct 1 09:59 JST, take the Rakuten Super SALE coupon.
Rakuten: 'ベッセルホテルカンパーナすすきの', Jan 31, 2 adults, standard twin, breakfast plan.
Use the big bath and sauna after the Furano drive.
Go to breakfast early on Feb 1 before the flight.
experience.tip: Susukino station exit 4 is 5 min away, easy with luggage.

title: Toyoko Inn Narita solo-use twin
titleJa: 東横INN成田空港本館 ひとり利用プラン
summary: Toyoko Inn Narita Airport sells a twin room for one person with breakfast and the free airport shuttle at less than its single price.
why: Pegasis gets a bigger room for the last night before flying home, for less money.
cost: ¥6,925 for 1 person, twin room, breakfast included (Jalan 'ひとり利用プラン', Mon Feb 1) vs about ¥9,764–10,254 normal single price on Jalan.
winterNote: Toyoko Club Card gives only 5% off and costs ¥1,500 to join, so it is not worth it for one night. Free shuttle bus to the terminals. Seen 25 Sep 2026.

experience.hook: Twin room for one, with breakfast, for under ¥7,000.
moments: Jalan: '東横INN成田空港本館', Feb 1, 1 adult.
Pick 'ひとり利用プラン' (twin, ¥6,925).
From the terminal take the free Toyoko shuttle bus.
Take the early shuttle back on Feb 2 after breakfast.
experience.tip: Do not buy the club card for one night; the fee is more than the saving.

title: Narita to Shinjuku without N'EX
titleJa: エアポートバス東京・成田（TYO-NRT）／スカイライナー
summary: Take the ¥1,500 Airport Bus Tokyo-Narita to Tokyo Station, then the JR Chuo Line to Shinjuku. If you want a train, the Skyliner online ticket to Nippori plus JR to Shinjuku is also cheaper than N'EX.
why: You save about ¥1,600 per person (bus) or about ¥800 per person (Skyliner) on arrival day. The N'EX round-trip ticket (¥5,200) does not help, because nobody goes back to Narita by train.
cost: Bus ¥1,500 + JR Tokyo→Shinjuku ~¥210 = ~¥1,710 pp, or Skyliner online ¥2,310 + JR Nippori→Shinjuku ~¥210 = ~¥2,520 pp, vs N'EX Narita→Shinjuku ¥3,325 pp (2026 fare)
winterNote: Bus ¥1,500 is for normal hours; late-night and early-morning buses cost ¥3,000. Bus needs no booking. Skyliner discount is online only (Keisei Skyliner e-ticket), not at the station. N'EX discount ticket 'Toku-wari' for N'EX ends Sep 30, 2026.

experience.hook: Same ride into Tokyo for half the N'EX price.
moments: After customs, follow the signs to the bus stops of the Airport Bus Tokyo-Narita (TYO-NRT).
Pay ¥1,500 at the ticket counter or machine (no booking needed); buses leave about every 10–20 min in the day.
Get off at Tokyo Station Yaesu side, walk into JR, tap Suica to Shinjuku (Chuo Line Rapid, ~15 min).
If you prefer a train: buy the Skyliner ticket online before the trip (¥2,310), ride to Nippori, change to JR Yamanote Line to Shinjuku.
experience.tip: With big ski bags the bus is easier: luggage goes under the bus, no stairs at Nippori.

title: Ski Annupuri, skip All-Mountain pass
titleJa: ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場 1日券
summary: Buy the Niseko Annupuri 1-day ticket instead of the Niseko United all-mountain ticket. Annupuri has wide gentle runs for Aoki and powder for Pegasis, and the ticket includes night skiing.
why: Saves ¥5,700 per person (¥11,400 for two) for one ski day.
cost: Annupuri 1-day ¥7,800 pp (5-hour ¥6,700) vs Niseko United all-mountain 1-day ¥13,500 pp; Hirafu+Hanazono online ¥11,800 (window ¥12,500)
winterNote: Peak season Dec 24, 2026–Feb 28, 2027. Annupuri hours 8:30–19:30 (night 16:30–19:30). Hirafu online price is ¥700 less than window price. Annupuri base is ~15 min drive from Kutchan.

experience.hook: Same Niseko powder, almost half the lift price.
moments: Drive from Hotel 3M Kutchan to Annupuri base (free parking).
Buy the Annupuri 1-day ticket at the counter (or online).
Aoki takes the green runs near the base; Pegasis rides the gondola to the top.
Stay for night skiing until 19:30 with the same ticket.
experience.tip: If you want Hirafu for one run, buy a single ride, not the ¥13,500 all-mountain ticket.

title: Hokkaido by train, not car
titleJa: 札幌・富良野エリアパス＋普通乗車券
summary: Do Hakodate→Kutchan→Otaru→Asahikawa→Biei→Furano→Sapporo by JR. Buy single tickets to Otaru, then the Sapporo-Furano Area Pass for the last 4 days.
why: For two people the train costs about ¥38,000 in total, the car about ¥70,000–100,000, so you save ¥30,000–60,000; no winter driving at night.
cost: Rail ~¥19,140 pp (Hakodate→Kutchan ¥6,760 + Kutchan→Otaru ¥1,380 + Sapporo-Furano Area Pass ¥11,000, which also covers Sapporo→New Chitose) vs car ~¥35,000–50,000 per person share (rental 5 days, one-way fee ¥11,000–27,000, HEP ¥9,600, fuel). Hokkaido Rail Pass 5 days ¥22,000 is NOT better than this.
winterNote: Hakodate→Kutchan is ~4 h with a change at Oshamambe; local trains on the Hakodate Line mountain section are few (check timetable). Blue Pond needs the Dohoku bus from Biei; Onuma is a stop of the Hokuto express. You lose the Hokkaido driving part of the trip. Sapporo-Furano Area Pass: 4 consecutive days, foreign passport.
photoQuery: JR Hokkaido Kamui limited express snow

experience.hook: Let the train drive through the blizzard.
moments: Jan 27: Hokuto express Hakodate→Oshamambe (stop at Onuma-koen on the way if you want), local train to Kutchan.
Jan 29: local train Kutchan→Otaru; start the Sapporo-Furano Area Pass here (Jan 29–Feb 1).
Otaru→Sapporo→Asahikawa by Kamui/Lilac; bus to Asahiyama Zoo.
Biei→Furano by local train; Blue Pond by Dohoku bus from Biei; Furano→Sapporo; Feb 1 train to New Chitose on the same pass.
experience.tip: Keep the car only for one day (e.g., Biei/Blue Pond from Asahikawa) if you still want to drive.

title: Shibuya Sky before 15:00 slot
titleJa: SHIBUYA SKY WEBチケット（14:59までの入場）
summary: Buy the official web ticket for an entry time before 15:00 and stay on the roof until sunset. Late-January sunset is about 16:50.
why: Saves ¥700 per person against the sunset slot and ¥1,000 against the counter price, and sunset slots often sell out.
cost: Web ¥2,700 (entry to 14:59) vs web ¥3,400 (15:00 and later) vs counter ¥3,000 / ¥3,700
winterNote: Web tickets go on sale 2 weeks ahead (for Jan 23 → about Jan 9, 2027, Japan time). If web is sold out, the counter is sold out too. Roof closes in strong wind or rain. Check on the site that there is no stay limit after entry.

experience.hook: Daytime price, sunset view.
moments: Jan 9, 2027 (Japan time): book the 14:30 or 14:40 entry on the official site.
Arrive from Kawaguchiko, drop bags, enter before 15:00.
Walk the roof in daylight, then keep your spot on the west side for Mt Fuji and the sunset at ~16:50.
Stay for the night view, then dinner in Shibuya.
experience.tip: Bring gloves; the open roof is very cold in January.

title: Sapporo subway card fare cap
titleJa: 札幌市営地下鉄 クレカ乗車 上限運賃
summary: Tap a Visa/Mastercard/JCB contactless card at Sapporo subway gates. The day's fares stop at the price of a 1-day ticket, with no ticket to buy.
why: On Sunday Jan 31 the cap is ¥520 (weekend price), on Monday Feb 1 ¥830; each ride is ¥210+, so 3+ rides are free after the cap.
cost: Max ¥520 pp on Sat/Sun/holidays, ¥830 pp weekdays, vs ¥210–380 per ride
winterNote: Started Mar 26, 2026. Subway only (not streetcar or JR). Each person needs own card; same card for all rides of the day.

experience.hook: Unlimited Sapporo subway for ¥520 with no ticket.
moments: Return the car on Jan 31 morning.
Tap your contactless credit card at the gate marked for card payment.
Ride Odori, Susukino, Sapporo Station as much as you like; the system stops charging at the cap.
Aoki: on Feb 1 use the same card until the train to the airport (JR is separate).
experience.tip: Use the same physical card or the same phone every time, or the cap does not add up.

title: Sapporo to Narita on LCC
titleJa: 新千歳→成田（ジェットスター／Peach）
summary: For Pegasis on Feb 1, Jetstar and Peach fly New Chitose→Narita from about ¥5,000. The JAL Japan Explorer Pass is the backup if you want a bag included.
why: LCC fares are about ¥10,000+ less than a normal full-service fare; note ANA's visitor fare no longer exists.
cost: Jetstar from ¥5,490 / low fares ~¥5,640 (plus bag fee) vs JAL Japan Explorer Pass (visitors only, price shown only in search) vs normal ANA/JAL fares ¥15,000+
winterNote: ANA's visitor fare (Experience/Discover JAPAN) ended May 18, 2026. JAL Explorer Pass: you must live outside Japan and hold an international ticket; no changes, no refunds. LCC base fares have no checked bag; ski bags cost extra. Snow delays are common at New Chitose in late January.

experience.hook: Last hop to Narita for the price of a lunch set.
moments: Sign up for Jetstar and Peach sale emails; both run domestic sales several times a year.
Book CTS→NRT for Feb 1 with one checked bag added (compare total with JAL Explorer Pass).
Take JR from Sapporo to New Chitose (~40 min).
Land at Narita T3/T1 and walk or bus to Toyoko Inn Narita Airport.
experience.tip: Jetstar and Peach use Narita Terminal 3; allow time to reach the hotel shuttle.

title: Hokkaido snow driving: real warnings
titleJa: 北海道 冬道運転の注意
summary: Chinese drivers who drove Hokkaido in winter 2025–26 share the same rules: slow down, no sudden braking or steering, and watch for black ice on roads that look dry. In a whiteout, follow the red-and-white arrow poles above the road edge and the tail lights ahead.
why: Aoki drives the 5-day Hakodate→Sapporo car and Pegasis has only 1 year of licence, so these tips cut the real risk on days 9–13.
cost: ¥0 (4WD rental costs more; notes say 4WD is worth it)
winterNote: XHS: 4 independent notes, latest Jan 2026 (Azure 01-09, 北海道旅居中 2025-12-03 with 303 likes/544 saves, 不是小小只 01-20, momo 03-21). Tips: new snow grips well, grey 'dry' road or roads before bridges/tunnels may be black ice; on ice use engine brake (L or B gear) instead of hard brake (top comment); in a whiteout turn on fog lights and hazards and stop at a konbini, gas station or michi-no-eki; if the navi sends you onto a small road with no tyre tracks for 500 m, turn back; keep the fuel tank full; plan to arrive before dark (about 16:30 in late Jan). Roaming phone numbers work for 110/119; some eSIMs have poor signal in the countryside.

places.en: Niseko to Otaru road (comment: 'rotten snow, easy to slide')

photoQuery: Hokkaido snowy road arrow sign winter driving

experience.hook: Five rules from people who slid, spun and still got there.
moments: Ask the rental desk for 4WD and check the studless winter tyres before you leave Hakodate.
Brake early and softly; on shiny grey road, shift to L or B and let the engine slow you.
In a whiteout, switch on fog lights, look up for the red-and-white arrow poles, and follow tail lights.
If snow keeps coming, pull into a Seicomart or michi-no-eki and wait it out with hot coffee.
Fill the tank at half, and aim to park before 16:30 when it gets dark.
experience.tip: If Google Maps sends you down a side road with no tyre tracks, turn around at once.

title: Aoki's first Niseko ski day
titleJa: ニセコ 初心者の一日
summary: XHS skiers agree: a beginner should start at Annupuri or Hanazono beginner runs, take a lesson, and buy only one resort's ticket or a half-day ticket. They also warn about one 'easy' tree run, Strawberry Fields, where going left leads to steep chutes.
why: Aoki is a beginner and Pegasis is good: this lets Aoki learn safely and cheaply while Pegasis skis the big mountain.
cost: Niseko United all-mountain 1-day ¥13,500 in peak season 2026-27 (official); a single-resort or half-day ticket costs less (price per resort not checked). Rental: notes say about ¥4,000 skis/board + ¥3,000 wear + ¥1,500 helmet.
winterNote: XHS: 4 independent notes, latest Feb 2026 (典伊选手 02-04: half-day ticket from about 10:00–12:00 was enough, buy on the resort site; Kico 02-06: 'Village is steep for beginners, choose Annupuri'; 硅谷hannah 01-07 on Strawberry Fields; 假装有年假 07-28 on rental prices and 2–3 lesson days). Last lift about 16:30. Official 2026-27 all-mountain peak 1-day ¥13,500 (Dec 24–Feb 28).

places.ja: ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場

photoQuery: Niseko Annupuri ski resort beginner slope

experience.hook: Aoki learns on soft powder while Pegasis rides the whole mountain.
moments: Rent skis, wear and helmet at the base; do not buy gear for a first trip.
Book Aoki a morning group or private lesson at Annupuri; stay on green runs only.
Buy a half-day ticket after lunch instead of an all-mountain day ticket.
Meet at the base for hot ramen, then ski the last run together before 16:30.
experience.tip: In Strawberry Fields, follow the coloured arrows and never drift left; skip Kamp Kitsune.

title: Hakodate locals' market, not Asaichi
titleJa: 函館自由市場
summary: Hakodate Jiyu Ichiba is the fish market where local people shop, 10 minutes' walk from Hakodate Station. You buy fresh uni, hairy crab and sashimi at local prices and eat some at the stalls.
why: Same Hokkaido seafood as the famous morning market, with fewer tourists and lower prices, near their day-8/9 hotel.
cost: Salt-water uni about ¥6,500 a box (Jan 2026 note); crab and sashimi by weight. Sushi bowl across OMO5 is 'about ¥1,000 less than at Asaichi'.
winterNote: XHS: 3 independent notes, latest Feb 2026 (很高兴说说少女 02-21, 243 likes/457 saves; Nothin 01-12; For BBQ 01-18, 440 likes/698 saves). Stalls mainly 6:00–13:00, go before 8:00 on weekends, some stalls are cash only. Closed days not checked: check before you go.

places.en: Hakodate Sushi (across the street from OMO5; OMO5 point shown)

experience.hook: Eat uni where Hakodate grandmothers buy their fish.
moments: Walk 10 minutes from Hakodate Station before 8:00 with cash in your pocket.
Ask at the crab stall for a boiled hairy crab and let them open it for you.
Buy a small box of salt-water uni and eat it with the free wasabi.
For dinner, walk in to Hakodate Sushi opposite OMO5 for a big kaisen-don.
experience.tip: Ask two or three stalls for the same item: notes say prices differ between stalls.

title: Otaru half fried chicken, ¥1,190
titleJa: 若鶏時代なると 本店
summary: A 70-year-old Otaru restaurant famous for a whole half chicken, deep-fried and salty. It has 270 seats, so you walk in without booking, 7–8 minutes from Otaru Station.
why: A hot, big, cheap meal after the cold canal walk on day 11, and no queue stress.
cost: Half chicken ¥1,190; chicken set meal ¥1,490 (official menu)
winterNote: XHS: many notes over years, 3 read, latest Jan 2026 (小手姐姐 01-06: 'big, fast, no reservation needed'; 吃汉阿祖 2025-03, 679 likes). One note says 'too salty'. Open 11:00–21:00 (LO 20:30), closed Jan 1 only.

experience.hook: Tear a crackling half chicken apart with your hands.
moments: Walk 8 minutes up Yanagawa-dori from Otaru Station in the snow.
Order one half chicken to share and a zangi fried chicken plate.
Pull the crispy skin off with the plastic gloves they give you.
Finish with the shop's own soft-serve ice cream at the front.
experience.tip: One half chicken for two is enough if you also want the canal sweets after.

title: Kodoku no Gurume izakaya, Asahikawa
titleJa: 独酌 三四郎
summary: Dokushaku Sanshiro is the old wooden izakaya from the drama Kodoku no Gurume's Asahikawa special. You eat shinko-yaki (grilled half young chicken with sweet sauce), thick tamagoyaki and grilled fish.
why: A screen-pilgrimage dinner that is also the local No.1 izakaya, on their Asahikawa night.
cost: Price not checked; notes say normal izakaya prices (about ¥3,000–4,000 per person is a guess, check)
winterNote: XHS: 3 independent notes, latest Feb 2026 (宅蘑菇Moku 02-13 'Asahikawa winter night, Kodoku izakaya'; pittxxii 2024-11, 126 likes; 安安娜贝儿 2025-07). Author said walk-in OK but it fills at dinner time. Coordinate is the block 3-jo-dori 5-chome (address from memory, check on Google Maps). Other Asahikawa pick from a Feb 2026 note: 焼き鳥八丁目 near the station, chicken wings, slow service.
anime: Kodoku no Gurume (TV drama), Asahikawa business-trip special: Goro orders shinko-yaki, tamagoyaki and grilled hokke

experience.hook: Order exactly what Goro ordered, with snow falling outside.
moments: Walk in at opening time and sit at the counter if there is space.
Order 'Goro's selection': shinko-yaki, tamagoyaki and grilled hokke.
Pour the sweet shinko-yaki sauce over a bowl of white rice.
Walk back to the Dormy Inn for the onsen and free late-night ramen.
experience.tip: Go at opening time; on busy nights walk-ins wait.

title: Sapporo's top-rated soup curry: SHO-RIN
titleJa: スープカレー SHO-RIN
summary: A Sapporo local's ranking of every soup curry shop puts SHO-RIN in Susukino at the top, above the famous GARAKU. You pick a soup, a spice level and toppings, and eat a big bowl of vegetables and chicken.
why: Hot, spicy, filling soup after a cold day; less queue than GARAKU.
cost: Price not checked (Sapporo soup curry is usually about ¥1,500–2,000)
winterNote: XHS: 3 independent notes, latest Jan 2026 (性转酷拉皮卡 ranking 2025-10, 3,692 likes/7,026 saves; 芝加歌 01-09 'SHO-RIN', 182 likes; 年久失修大电风扇 01-13). Same ranking says skip 'Curry House' at New Chitose airport. Opening hours not checked.

experience.hook: The soup curry a local ranked above GARAKU.
moments: Walk to Susukino, south of Tanuki-koji, and put your names on the list.
Pick a soup base, a spice level and chicken leg or pork.
Dip the rice into the soup one spoon at a time, the local way.
Walk off the heat under the Susukino lights.
experience.tip: Start at spice level 3 or lower: levels climb fast.

title: ¥100 bento after 19:40 in Sapporo
titleJa: まいばすけっと 値下げ弁当
summary: Small AEON-group supermarkets in Sapporo (Maibasket) cut bento prices hard at night. A Jan 2026 note shows a ¥594 hamburg bento sold for ¥108 after about 19:40.

cost: ¥108 vs ¥594 normal (bento, Jan 2026 photo)
winterNote: XHS: 3 notes, latest Jan 2026 (喵喵大人 01-16 at まいばすけっと北2条西14丁目店: 'any shop with the AEON logo works'; 多肉车厘子 'half-price sushi after 19:00'; Lost And Found on discount times). Discounts vary by shop and day; it is not a promise. Different from the depachika half-price idea.

Go at 19:40–20:30 and look for yellow 値下げ or red 半額 stickers.
Take a bento and onigiri for breakfast back to the hotel fridge.

title: Biei: quiet Fudo falls, skip frozen Blue Pond
titleJa: 白金不動の滝
summary: XHS notes warn that the Blue Pond in winter is white snow, not blue, and Shirogane Blue River bridge is packed with tour groups. Instead stop at Shirogane Fudo-no-taki, a short snowy forest path one stop before Shirogane Onsen, then walk 1 km to Shirahige falls.
why: Gives their day-12 Biei stop a quiet snow-forest walk and real photos, not only a crowded bridge.
cost: ¥0; street stalls near Shirogane sell hot croquettes and beef skewers (price not checked)
winterNote: XHS: 4 independent notes, latest Feb 2026 (艾琳酱 02-02, 362 likes/493 saves: Fudo falls path; 小红薯 01-14 and lu小鹿 02-22: 'do not come to Blue Pond in winter'; 柴犬姜糖糖 03-02: many Biei shops close on Wednesday). Blue Pond light-up may still be worth it at night: check 2027 dates. Path is snow; wear boots with grip.

experience.hook: A silent snow forest one stop before the tour buses.
moments: Park at the Fudo-no-taki sign before Shirogane Onsen.
Walk the snow path under heavy white trees to the small falls.
Drive or walk 1 km on to Shirahige falls and its blue stream.
Eat a hot croquette from the stall by the bridge.
experience.tip: Do not plan Biei cafés on a Wednesday: many close.

title: Biei Blue River snowshoe tour
titleJa: 美瑛 青い川 スノーシュー
summary: A small-group guided snowshoe walk through Biei forest to a blue river, then a stop at Shirahige falls. Notes say it is flat, easy for beginners, and fun: you can slide down on your bottom.
why: An easy snow activity both can do, with a guide who shows animal tracks and powder snow.
cost: ¥8,000 per person for 2+ (¥12,000 solo), Field North, last season's price
winterNote: XHS: 3 independent notes, latest Mar 2026 (lxlexy 02-15, 216 likes: Field North guide, 'hard to get a slot, watch for cancellations'; 柴犬姜糖糖 03-02: another guide, 17 people at Chinese New Year; 小熊软糖 01-12). Official: Blue River tour runs Dec 12–Mar 22, 9:30 or 13:15, meet at Oka no Kura near JR Biei Station; book by web form early.

experience.hook: Walk on top of deep powder to a river the colour of ice.
moments: Meet the guide at Oka no Kura by Biei Station at 13:15.
Strap on snowshoes and follow the tracks into the white forest.
Shake a snowy tree over your friend, then slide down a slope on your bottom.
Stand over the blue river, then see Shirahige falls on the way back.
experience.tip: Wear waterproof pants and gloves; the guide gives shoe covers.

title: Sapporo value hotels from XHS

Another note rates 'the b Sapporo' by Tanuki-koji at CNY 350 (about ¥7,000) with free snacks and coffee in the lobby.

Prices change fast in Snow Festival season; check Jan 31 2027 prices on Expedia/Jalan.

experience.hook: A big old-style room for less than a business hotel.
moments: Compare Jan 31 prices for Garden Palace, the b and Dormy Inn on 2–3 sites.
Book free-cancel, then check again in December.
Walk 10 minutes to Odori; take a taxi if you arrive at night with bags on snow.
experience.tip: If Dormy Inn is cheaper that night, keep it: free onsen and ramen win.

title: New Chitose airport: eat this, skip that
titleJa: 新千歳空港 グルメ
summary: A Dec 2025 'red and black list' of New Chitose airport food: buy Calbee fresh-fried chips, Snow Cheese and Sapporo Nogakko milk cookies. It says skip Rokkatei rum-raisin cookies (too sweet) and the fish-cake stall; a soup-curry ranker says skip 'Curry House'.
why: The last Hokkaido meal and gifts on Feb 1–2 without wasting money on tourist traps.
cost: Snacks and gifts, from a few hundred yen (prices not checked)
winterNote: XHS: 3 independent notes, latest Jan 2026 (Kiyokawa Niyo 2025-12-20, 243 likes; 悦悦大冬瓜 01-18 'go for Sapporo Nogakko'; soup-curry ranking 2025-10 on Curry House). Arrive 3+ hours early: notes say 3 hours is not enough to see it all. Most food is in the domestic terminal.
photoQuery: New Chitose Airport domestic terminal shops

experience.hook: Spend the last yen on the airport snacks locals rate.
moments: Queue 10 minutes for Calbee chips fried in front of you.
Buy Snow Cheese rolls, sold only at the airport and Sapporo.
Pick Sapporo Nogakko milk cookies as gifts; they travel well.
Eat ramen or soup curry in the domestic terminal, not at Curry House.

title: See a real show at SHELTER
titleJa: 下北沢SHELTER ライブ

anime: Bocchi the Rock!: SHELTER is the model for STARRY, where Kessoku Band plays its first live

experience.hook: Stand in STARRY's real basement while a Tokyo band plays loud.

Print the ticket at a 7-Eleven or FamilyMart on the way.
Walk down the poster-covered stairs under the neon SHELTER sign when your number is called.
Buy the ¥600 drink ticket, grab a can, and stand near the back.

title: Akihabara: skip street-tout maid cafés
titleJa: 秋葉原 客引きメイド 注意

why: Protects the day-2 maid café budget; the real cafés already in ideas.json cost much less for more fun.

winterNote: XHS: 2 notes read, latest Jul 2026 (momo 02-23, 121 likes/57 comments: tout led them through side streets to a tiny room, 'real ones have queues'; comment from another user: '¥2,500 per hour with drinks and a show' at a normal shop; upupup 07-21: long article that street touting and '40 minutes over ¥10,000' 'concept cafés' are now common while classic maid cafés close). The same search shows several other 避雷 (avoid) notes, not read. Chiyoda ward bans street touting, so a tout is itself a warning sign (rule known, not checked for 2026).

experience.hook: Smile, say 'daijoubu', and keep walking.
moments: Pick your maid café before you arrive: @home, Maidreamin or Cure Maid.
Walk past maids with menus on Chuo-dori; a tout is not a café.
Before you sit anywhere, ask for the price list: entry, drink, photo, tax.
Leave if the room is in an old walk-up with no other customers.

title: Ikebukuro anime goods route, 2026
titleJa: 池袋 アニメグッズ巡り（アニメイト・K-BOOKS・駿河屋）
summary: XHS fans say Ikebukuro, not Akihabara, is now the best place to buy anime goods (谷子). Start at the 9-floor Animate main store, cross the street to Surugaya and Lashinbang for used goods, then walk the row of K-BOOKS shops toward Sunshine City.

Animate Café Ikebukuro / Otome Road side

experience.hook: Nine floors of new goods, then a street of used treasure.
moments: Walk 8 minutes from Ikebukuro East Exit (north side) to the blue Animate tower.
Ride to the top of Animate and work down floor by floor.
Cross the road to Surugaya 1F and Lashinbang 3F for cheap used badges and stands.
Hop through the K-BOOKS buildings on the way to Sunshine City.

title: Tokyu Stay Shinjuku: washer in room
titleJa: 東急ステイ新宿

why: For 4 Tokyo nights in winter, free in-room laundry of heavy clothes saves coin-laundry time; price is close to Gracery.
cost: About 1,100 CNY (≈ ¥23,000) per night in 2026 (XHS comment, room type not stated) vs Gracery ~¥26,000 twin. Not checked for Jan 2027 dates.

Official site: Deluxe Twin 30 m² has washer-dryer, mini kitchen and microwave; Superior Queen and Deluxe King have washer-dryer and microwave. Breakfast ¥2,530. Check twin price on the official site or Expedia before booking.

experience.hook: Wash the ski socks in your room while you eat ramen downstairs.
moments: Book the Deluxe Twin, the room type with washer-dryer and mini kitchen.
Throw in the day's clothes before dinner in Shinjuku-sanchome.
Warm a konbini bento in the room microwave after a late night.
Pack dry, clean clothes on day 6 before the Tohoku snow.
experience.tip: Ask for a twin with the washer-dryer; not every room type has the mini kitchen.

title: Via Inn Shinjuku, cheap and clean
titleJa: ヴィアイン新宿

why: A plain, clean base for less money than Gracery; the airport bus link helps on day 1 and the last day.
cost: Solo traveller paid a little over 4,000 CNY for 8 nights (≈ ¥10,500 a night, summer 2026) and says it was about 2,000 CNY less than the two other hotels. Twin price for Jan 2027 not checked.

Room not big but a 34-inch suitcase fits open; TV takes phone mirroring; 5 min walk to Shinjuku-sanchome, close to Isetan. Weak points: only one Lawson nearby. Airport bus: go down at Shinjuku-sanchome exit E1, walk the underground passage toward Takashimaya to Busta Shinjuku 4F (about 20 min, dry in rain or snow). Check whether a twin room exists.

experience.hook: A clean, quiet room five minutes from Isetan's food hall.
moments: Ride the airport bus into Busta Shinjuku and walk underground to the hotel.
Drop bags, then walk to Isetan's basement for half-price dinner after 19:30.
Cast anime clips from your phone to the room TV at night.
On departure day, walk the dry underground passage back to Busta 4F.

title: East Hokkaido drift ice road trip
titleJa: 道東ドライブ（網走・知床・摩周・阿寒・鶴居）
summary: Fly New Chitose to Memanbetsu, rent a 4WD car and drive Abashiri (icebreaker Aurora) → Utoro/Shiretoko → Lake Mashu and Lake Kussharo swans → Lake Akan Ainu Kotan → Tsurui red-crowned cranes, then fly out of Kushiro. It replaces baseline days 11–14 (Otaru, Asahikawa, Biei, Furano, Sapporo).
why: Aoki can drive, you get the wildest winter scenery in Japan (sea ice, cranes, frozen lakes, onsen towns), and Kushiro has direct flights to Haneda for Pegasis on Feb 1.
cost: about ¥60,000–80,000 pp (domestic flights ¥10,000–20,000 each way, 4WD rental ~¥12,000/day shared, Aurora ¥7,000, onsen hotels ¥10,000–18,000)
winterNote: Day plan: D11 Jan29 Niseko→New Chitose (~2 h) fly to Memanbetsu, Abashiri. D12 Jan30 Aurora icebreaker 9:00/11:00, drive Abashiri→Utoro (~75 km, ~1 h 20 min). D13 Jan31 Utoro→Shari→Lake Mashu 1st observatory→Sunayu swans on Lake Kussharo→Akan onsen (~200 km, ~3.5–4 h driving). D14 Feb1 Akan→Tsurumidai cranes (~1 h)→Kushiro airport (~30 min), fly. Drift ice: Abashiri first sighting 2026 was Jan 22, shore contact Feb 1 (3 days earlier than normal); in late Jan ice may still be offshore or absent. Shiretoko Pass (Utoro↔Rausu) is closed all winter. Guided drift ice walks (e.g. SHINRA) start Feb 1. Akan ice festival 2026 ran Feb 1–Mar 1, so fireworks may not have started by Jan 31. Safety: rentals in Hokkaido come with studless tyres, ask for 4WD; drive only in daylight (sunset ~16:15), roads can be ice-covered and whiteouts happen on open farmland (e.g. near Shari/Koshimizu); check road info before each day and keep 30–50% extra time. Aoki should be the main driver.

places.ja: 網走流氷観光砕氷船おーろら（道の駅 流氷街道網走）
道の駅 うとろ・シリエトク

experience.hook: Four days of sea ice, frozen lakes, wild swans and dancing cranes by 4WD.
moments: Stand on the deck of the Aurora icebreaker in Abashiri and hear sea ice crack under the hull.
Drive the Okhotsk coast to Utoro and watch the sea turn white near Oronko Rock at sunset.
Look down into frozen Lake Mashu from the 1st Observatory, a round blue-white bowl in the mountains.
Dig into the warm sand at Sunayu on Lake Kussharo while whooper swans float on the steaming water.
Watch red-crowned cranes call and dance in the snow at Tsurumidai before your Kushiro flight.
experience.tip: Drive only in daylight, sunset is about 16:15. Book the first Aurora sailing: fewer people on the bow deck.

title: Asahikawa to Abashiri via Sounkyo
titleJa: 旭川→層雲峡→網走 ドライブ
summary: Keep the baseline up to the Asahiyama Zoo, then drive east: night at Sounkyo Onsen for the Ice Waterfall Festival, next day over Sekihoku Pass to Abashiri for the Aurora icebreaker, then fly home side from Memanbetsu. It replaces Biei/Furano/Sapporo (days 12 afternoon–14).
why: A shorter, lower-risk taste of the east: ice festival, onsen, and a chance of sea ice, with only two driving days.
cost: about ¥45,000–60,000 pp (car ~¥12,000/day shared, Sounkyo ryokan ¥12,000–20,000, festival ¥1,000, Aurora ¥7,000, flight Memanbetsu→Haneda ¥15,000–30,000)
winterNote: Sounkyo Ice Waterfall Festival 2027: Jan 23–Mar 7 (weekday 17:00–21:30, weekend from 11:00). Asahikawa→Sounkyo about 70 km (~1 h 15 min); Sounkyo→Abashiri about 160 km (~2 h 45 min) over Sekihoku Pass, which is a mountain pass with snow and ice, drive in daylight only. Drift ice in Abashiri is not sure in late Jan (2026: first sighting Jan 22). Aurora runs Jan 20–Mar 31 (2027 plan). Memanbetsu airport is ~25 min from Abashiri.

places.ja: 道の駅 流氷街道網走

experience.hook: Glowing ice towers, a hot onsen, then an icebreaker on the Okhotsk Sea.
moments: Drive east from Asahikawa into the Sounkyo gorge, with cliffs and frozen waterfalls beside the road.
Walk through lit ice tunnels and towers at the Ice Waterfall Festival, then soak in your hotel onsen.
Cross Sekihoku Pass in morning light, through white forest with almost no other cars.
Ride the Aurora icebreaker out of Abashiri for one hour, looking for sea ice and eagles.
experience.tip: Leave Sounkyo early; the pass needs daylight. Check the Japan Coast Guard drift ice map the night before the cruise.

title: Shift trip for Sapporo Snow Festival
titleJa: さっぽろ雪まつり
summary: Move the whole 15-day trip 9 days later (Thu Jan 28 – Thu Feb 11, 2027) so the Hokkaido week (days 8–14 = Feb 4–10) falls inside the Sapporo Snow Festival (Feb 4–11). The Asahikawa Winter Festival (Feb 6–11) then also lines up with days 11–12.
why: Giant snow sculptures at Odori, ice sculptures in Susukino, and snow slides at Tsudome, plus a better chance of drift ice in February.

winterNote: 2027 Snow Festival: Feb 4 (Thu)–Feb 11 (Thu, holiday), Odori, Tsudome and Susukino sites. Aoki's 15-day visa limit: Jan 28–Feb 11 inclusive is exactly 15 days, so do not add a day. places.ja: 旭川冬まつり（常磐公園周辺）

Watch light shows projected onto the big snow sculptures after dark.
Walk the Susukino ice sculptures at night, with ramen and bars on every side.
Slide down long snow slides at the Tsudome site like kids.
Take a day trip to the Asahikawa Winter Festival and its giant snow stage.

title: Lake Shikotsu Ice Festival
titleJa: 千歳・支笏湖氷濤まつり
summary: Walk-through ice sculptures and ice caves made from blue lake water, lit in many colours after dark. It is 40 min by car from New Chitose Airport, so it fits the last Sapporo day.

moments: Walk into ice caves and towers made by spraying Lake Shikotsu water onto frames until it freezes.
Look at the natural 'Shikotsu blue' of the ice in the afternoon light.
Stay as the colored lights switch on at 16:30 and the ice glows.
Listen to the ice creak in the cold, then warm up in a Shikotsu onsen nearby.

title: Tomamu Ice Village and ski
titleJa: 星野リゾート トマム アイスヴィレッジ
summary: A small town of ice domes at Hoshino Resorts Tomamu with an ice bar, ice skating, ice slide and ice restaurant, open in the evening. By day, ski Tomamu and ride to the Frost Tree Terrace (霧氷テラス) at 1,088 m.

experience.hook: Ski by day, then drink from a glass made of ice at night.
moments: Ride the gondola to the Frost Tree Terrace at 1,088 m and see trees coated in white frost.
Ski Tomamu's wide groomed runs: fast ones for the good skier, easy ones for the beginner.
Walk the Ice Village at night: ice dome hotel, ice chapel, ice rink with light projections.
Drink at the Ice Bar from an ice glass, then ride the ice slide down.
Eat ice cheese fondue or the 'iceberg' bouillabaisse at the Ice Restaurant.

title: Sounkyo Ice Waterfall Festival
titleJa: 層雲峡温泉氷瀑まつり
summary: Ice towers, tunnels and an ice shrine built by the river in the Sounkyo gorge, lit up at night. Stay in a Sounkyo onsen hotel or do an evening trip from Asahikawa.
why: Ice festival plus onsen in one stop, only ~1 h 15 min from Asahikawa where you already stay.

experience.hook: Walk through glowing ice tunnels in a gorge, then soak in hot spring water.

Go through the ice tunnels and visit the small ice shrine.
Feel the gorge air at about -15°C while your breath freezes on your scarf.
Walk back to your hotel and soak in the onsen with snow falling outside.

title: Garinko icebreaker at Mombetsu
titleJa: 流氷砕氷船ガリンコ号III IMERU
summary: A 1-hour cruise on an icebreaker with big drills at the bow that cut through drift ice off Mombetsu. From Asahikawa it is about 2 h 30 min by car on the Asahikawa-Mombetsu expressway, or fly Haneda–Mombetsu.
why: The drift-ice boat closest to your baseline route (Asahikawa), for a unique winter sight.

experience.hook: A ship with two giant screw drills that grinds its way through sea ice.
moments: Board Garinko III IMERU at Mombetsu port and walk to the bow deck.
Watch the two red screw drills at the front roll onto the ice and crush it.
Hear the grinding and cracking as white ice plates split into blue sea water.
Visit the Okhotsk Tower after the cruise, an observatory that stands out in the sea.

title: Lake Toya and Noboribetsu Hells
titleJa: 洞爺湖温泉・登別地獄谷
summary: Instead of Onuma→Niseko, drive Hakodate→Lake Toya (lakeside onsen, view of Showa-Shinzan) and on to Noboribetsu, walking the steaming Jigokudani 'Hell Valley' and soaking in a big onsen hotel. Continue to Rusutsu for ski the next day.

winterNote: Hakodate→Toya about 2 h 30 min, Toya→Noboribetsu about 1 h by car. Jigokudani paths can be icy, wear shoe spikes. Toya Onsen normally has short nightly fireworks in winter too; 2027 schedule not checked.

experience.hook: A volcano lake onsen, then a steaming valley that smells of sulfur.
moments: Soak in a lakeside onsen at Toya and look out at the dark water and snowy Showa-Shinzan volcano.
Watch the short winter fireworks over Lake Toya from your room, if they run in 2027.
Walk the boardwalk through Jigokudani 'Hell Valley', with steam vents and the smell of sulfur all around.
See the red oni demon statues around Noboribetsu town and the Enma statue at Enmado.
Try many baths from different hot springs in one big Noboribetsu onsen hotel.

title: Rusutsu, Kiroro, Teine, Furano ski
titleJa: ルスツ・キロロ・サッポロテイネ・富良野スキー場
summary: Other ski areas on the baseline route: Rusutsu (big, fewer crowds than Niseko), Kiroro (very deep snow, between Otaru and Niseko), Sapporo Teine (40 min from Sapporo, 1972 Olympic runs) and Furano (on day 13). Each has good beginner slopes and ski school for Aoki.

experience.hook: Deep January powder at four resorts, each with easy runs for beginners.
moments: Ride through the trees at Rusutsu, with three mountains and far fewer people than Niseko.
Ski the deep, soft snow at Kiroro, one of the snowiest resorts in Hokkaido.
Ski down Sapporo Teine's Olympic runs with the sea and Sapporo city below you.
Take the Furano ropeway up and look out over the snowy Tokachi mountains.
experience.tip: Book a half-day ski school lesson for the beginner in the morning; the good skier explores, then meet for lunch.

title: Nikka Yoichi and Tenguyama
titleJa: ニッカウヰスキー余市蒸溜所・小樽天狗山
summary: On the Otaru day, visit the Nikka Yoichi whisky distillery (free guided tour with tasting, about 1 h) and ride the Tenguyama ropeway for a view over Otaru and the sea; Tenguyama also has a small ski area.

winterNote: Nikka tour: online booking only, opens about 1 month before, no same-day entry; closed Dec 23–Jan 7 (so late Jan is open). The driver cannot taste. Tenguyama ropeway runs in winter; check for wind stops.

places.ja: ニッカウヰスキー余市蒸溜所
天狗山ロープウェイ山麓駅

experience.hook: Whisky made over coal fires, then Otaru harbor lights from a mountain top.

Watch the pot stills heated by coal fire, the same old method founder Taketsuru learned in Scotland.
See Taketsuru's old house, then taste the free Nikka samples at the end of the tour.
Ride the Tenguyama ropeway at dusk and rub the tengu's long nose for luck.
Look down at Otaru harbor lights, one of Hokkaido's three famous night views.

title: Sapporo ramen, beer and shrine
titleJa: 元祖さっぽろラーメン横丁・サッポロビール博物館・北海道神宮

winterNote: All open in winter. Beer Museum tasting is paid; check hours before (not verified for 2027).

places.ja: サッポロビール博物館
元祖さっぽろラーメン横丁

experience.hook: Snowy shrine, beer in red brick, and miso ramen: three Sapporo classics.
moments: Walk through Maruyama Park's snowy forest to Hokkaido Jingu and its quiet wooden shrine.
Eat a warm grilled mochi 'Hangan-sama' at the teahouse inside the shrine grounds.
Taste beer in the red-brick Sapporo Beer Museum, including a beer you can only drink there.
Grill Genghis Khan lamb on a dome-shaped iron pan at the Sapporo Beer Garden next door.
End in Ganso Ramen Yokocho in Susukino with a bowl of rich miso ramen with butter and corn.

title: Jozankei Onsen night
titleJa: 定山渓温泉
summary: Sapporo's own onsen town in a snowy river valley, about 1 h from the city by bus or car. Stay one night between Furano and the flight instead of a business hotel.
why: A proper onsen night close to Sapporo and New Chitose, good last night for both of you.
cost: onsen hotel about ¥12,000–25,000 pp with dinner
winterNote: The snow candle event Yukitouro ran Jan 27–Feb 3, 2026 at Jozankei Shrine and was called the FINAL edition in this form; organisers say a new 'yukitouro' will come later. 2027 dates and form are unknown.

experience.hook: Sapporo's onsen town in a snowy river valley, one hour from the city.
moments: Take the bus from Sapporo into the deep valley as the snow gets thicker.
Walk the river path to the red Futami suspension bridge over a steaming stream.
Look for the green kappa water-spirit statues all around town.
Soak your feet in the free public foot bath, then soak in your hotel's river-view open-air bath.
experience.tip: Book the Kappa Liner bus from Sapporo. Get a room with dinner included; the town has few restaurants at night.

title: Lake Akan Ainu Kotan and cranes
titleJa: 阿寒湖アイヌコタン・鶴見台
summary: At Lake Akan, see the Ainu village street and an Ainu dance or the 'Lost Kamuy' show, and walk on the frozen lake (snowmobile, banana boat, fireworks during the ice festival). Next morning drive to Tsurui to watch wild red-crowned cranes at a feeding site.
why: Ainu culture and famous cranes are things you cannot see anywhere else in Japan.
duration: 1–2 days (part of an east Hokkaido plan)
cost: Ainu theatre about ¥2,000–4,000 (not verified); festival free; crane viewing free or small donation
winterNote: Akan ice festival 'ICE・愛す・阿寒 冬華美' 2026: Feb 1–Mar 1 (fireworks 20:00; ice surface activities in that period); 2027 dates not yet out. Cranes gather at winter feeding sites in Tsurui from about Nov to Mar (feeding times not verified). Akan→Tsurumidai about 1 h.

places.ja: 鶴居・伊藤タンチョウサンクチュアリ

experience.hook: Ainu songs by a frozen lake, then wild cranes dancing in the snow.
moments: Walk the Akan Ainu Kotan street, full of carved wood shops, in a village of about 120 Ainu people.
Watch 'Lost Kamuy' at the Ainu Theater Ikor, a show with Ainu dance and digital images.
Walk out onto frozen Lake Akan and, in festival time, watch fireworks over the ice.
Watch wild red-crowned cranes call and dance in the snowy field at Tsurumidai.
Stand on Otowa Bridge at dawn to see cranes in the river mist on very cold mornings.
experience.tip: For Otowa Bridge, arrive before sunrise on a day below -15°C; the river steam and frost are strongest then.

title: @home café, classic Akihabara maid café
titleJa: あっとほぉーむカフェ
summary: The best-known maid café chain in Akihabara; maids greet you with 'Welcome home, Master/Princess'. You order food or a drink, the maids cast the 'moe moe kyun' spell on it, and you can buy an instant photo (cheki) with a maid.
why: It is the easiest, most beginner-friendly way to see the maid café culture you see in anime, with English menus and card/Alipay/WeChat payment.
cost: Admission ¥850 (ages 23–59; ¥600 ages 19–22) + at least 1 drink (¥720–900). Drink course incl. cheki ¥1,690; food course ¥2,810; full course ¥3,810. Extra cheki ¥870 (large ¥1,080). Total about ¥2,500–4,700.
winterNote: Indoor, open all year. Maids change costumes for seasonal 'cos days'. Weekends and evenings have a queue; use the at-Entry queue ticket or at-PASS reservation on the site. Electronic money (IC) payment ends Oct 2026; cards, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay still OK.

places.ja: あっとほぉーむカフェ ドンキ店
あっとほぉーむカフェ AKIBAカルチャーズZONE店

photoQuery: Akihabara maid cafe Don Quijote building

experience.hook: Maids greet you in chorus and draw on your omurice in ketchup.
moments: Hear the whole café call 'Welcome home, Master!' as you step in and get your at-home key card.
Order the Hiyoko-san omurice and ask the maid to draw a picture on it in ketchup.
Make heart hands and chant 'moe moe kyun' with your maid to make the food 'tastier'.
Pick a maid and pose for a cheki photo; she decorates it with drawings at your table.
experience.tip: The Drink Course (¥1,690) already includes one cheki. It is the cheapest full experience if you are not hungry.

title: Maidreamin, maid café with stage shows
titleJa: めいどりーみん 秋葉原本店
summary: Big maid café chain with 7 shops in Akihabara, open until 23:00. Every shop has a small stage where maids sing and dance, and first-timers get a 'Maidreamin passport'.
why: Loud, bright and fun for a first visit, and the late hours fit an evening after a full day of anime spots.
cost: Entry ¥880 per hour (adult) + food/drink. Official average: ¥1,500 soft drink only, ¥2,000–2,500 with food, ¥2,500–3,500 with alcohol and a live show. Photo with a maid is extra.
winterNote: Indoor, open every day. Honten: Mon–Fri 11:30–23:00, Sat/Sun/holidays 10:30–23:00. No table or service charge. Payment: cash, cards, PayPay, WeChat Pay, Alipay. Reservation form on the site.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 秋葉原本店
めいどりーみん Heaven's Gate

experience.hook: Get a passport to the 'dream country' and watch maids perform live.
moments: Receive your Maidreamin passport and choose the name the maids will call you.
Say the spell 'oishiku nare, moe moe kyun' together with the maid over your drink.
Watch a maid song-and-dance show on the small stage between orders.
Take a commemorative photo with the maid you like before you 'leave the country'.
experience.tip: Entry is charged per hour, so order at once and watch the clock. For a bigger show, pick the Heaven's Gate live restaurant.

title: Cure Maid Café, the first maid café
titleJa: キュアメイドカフェ
summary: Opened in 2001, it calls itself Japan's first maid café. It is calm: classic long maid uniforms, good tea and scones, and a changing anime collaboration menu.
why: A quiet, historic spot for anime fans; it appears as a model in 'Love Live!' and 'Saekano' and always runs an anime collab.
cost: No entry charge found on the official site. Tea ¥770; food/collab menus extra. About ¥1,500–3,000.
winterNote: Open 11:00–20:00 daily (food L.O. 19:00). Moved: now in Onoden Bldg 4F (Gee! Store Akiba) by the station. Numbered tickets when busy; seat reservation only for paid 'supporter card' members. Collab cafés change about every 2 weeks; check what runs on Jan 20, 2027.
anime: Love Live! and Saekano (How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend) use it as a model; rotating official anime collab menus

experience.hook: Drink real tea where the maid café started, back in 2001.
moments: Ride the Onoden escalator to 4F and walk through the Gee! Store to the café.
Order a pot of Darjeeling or smoky Lapsang souchong from the tea list, ¥770.
Try a scone or waffle while maids in long classic dresses serve quietly.
Check the collab menu and goods of whatever anime runs that fortnight.
experience.tip: Photos of your food are fine, but keep staff and other guests out of the frame, and no video.

title: Cafe Mai:lish, quiet classic maid café
titleJa: カフェ メイリッシュ
summary: One of the older Akihabara maid cafés, calm and relaxed. No table charge: one order per 90 minutes, and the tea is certified by the Japan Tea Association.
why: A more authentic, less showy maid café for when the loud chains feel too much; no entry fee keeps it cheap.
cost: No table charge; 1 order per 90 min. About ¥1,000–2,500.
winterNote: Closed on Wednesdays, so NOT on day 2 (Wed Jan 20, 2027). Mon/Tue/Thu 14:00–22:00, Fri–Sun/holidays 12:00–22:00. Every Thursday is 'Classical Maid Day' (day 3 evening fits). Phone reservations only on weekdays, up to 1 month ahead; no reservations on weekends.

experience.hook: A calm maid café where nobody rushes you: one order buys 90 minutes.
moments: Climb to the 2nd floor of FH Kyowa Square on Sotokanda 3-chome.
Order tea and scones; on Thursdays the maids wear classic uniforms with a special tea menu.
Charge your phone at the table and rest your legs after the Akihabara crowds.
Collect a stamp for each ¥1,000 you spend on the original stamp card.
experience.tip: Go on Thursday evening (day 3) for Classical Maid Day. Ask staff first before you photograph your food.

title: Swallowtail butler café, Ikebukuro
titleJa: 執事喫茶 スワロウテイル
summary: A Victorian-style tea salon near Otome Road where butlers in tailcoats serve you. You pick your teacup from over 50, and eat a set meal or afternoon tea.
why: The elegant 'reverse' of a maid café, famous in otome and anime culture; men are welcome too.
cost: 1 set per person is required: ¥5,400 (e.g. pasta + salad + drink, or scones + savoury + dessert tea set); dinner course ¥7,900. Cash or credit card only (no e-money).
winterNote: Advance web reservation with an account is required; walk-in only if there is a same-day cancellation ('today's free seats' on the site). Tea time 10:30–18:15, dinner 18:30–21:15. Arrive 50+ min late = refused and cancellation fee. Menu changes monthly; book as soon as January dates open.

experience.hook: A butler opens the door and calls you home to a Victorian mansion.
moments: Wait by the basement entrance until the doorman checks your booking and a butler escorts you in.
Choose your teacup from more than 50 in the cup selection.
Eat the monthly set, like scones with two jams and creams, or seasonal pasta.
Relax to the end; a butler comes 20–30 minutes before your time ends to settle the bill.
experience.tip: Absolutely no photos inside, with no exceptions. Ask the doorman where you may photograph the entrance.

title: Otome Road and Animate Café
titleJa: 乙女ロード・アニメイトカフェ池袋
summary: Ikebukuro's Otome Road is the fan street for female anime fans. Eat at an official Animate Café anime collab and drink a 'Gratte' latte with a character printed on the cream.
why: Real anime collab food and goods in one short walk, with the Animate Ikebukuro main store next door.
cost: Collab café: about ¥2,000–3,000 (check each event). Gratte latte: about ¥1,000 (check). No reservation needed for Gratte.
winterNote: Collab titles change every few weeks; check animatecafe.jp in Dec 2026 for Jan 2027 events. Some collabs need an online seat reservation, others are 'free entry'. Gratte at Animate Ikebukuro main store 10:00–20:00; numbered tickets when busy.

places.ja: アニメイトカフェ池袋
執事喫茶 スワロウテイル

anime: Changing official collabs (whatever runs in Jan 2027)

experience.hook: Drink a latte with your favourite character printed on the foam.
moments: Walk Otome Road past shops full of character goods and doujinshi.
Order a Gratte and photograph the character printed on the cream before it melts.
Eat a themed collab dish and get a random bonus coaster or card.
Browse the floors of the Animate Ikebukuro main store for goods.
experience.tip: Pick the collab first on animatecafe.jp, then check if it needs a timed reservation. Many collabs sell out on the first days.

title: Pokémon Café Tokyo, Nihonbashi
titleJa: ポケモンカフェ TOKYO
summary: The official Pokémon café in Nihonbashi Takashimaya. You eat Pokémon-shaped food, and Pikachu comes out for a short live show.
why: A playful, very photogenic meal for anime and game fans, with English and simplified Chinese menus.
cost: About ¥2,500–4,000 per person for a dish, a drink and a dessert (estimate; check menu).
winterNote: Reservation only, via the official site; opening time for bookings can change (it is usually about one month ahead, check the news page). Same-day seats only from cancellations at the door. Open 10:30–21:00, L.O. 20:30.

experience.hook: Pikachu walks out and dances beside your table.
moments: Go up to 5F of the Takashimaya East building near Tokyo Station.
Order a Pokémon-shaped dish and a souvenir-menu drink that comes with a café-only item.
Watch the Pikachu show, about 10 minutes long.
Buy café-only goods in the shop before your 90 minutes end.
experience.tip: Set a reminder for the day bookings open; slots go in minutes. Each email address can book only one slot.

title: Kirby Café at Tokyo Skytree
titleJa: カービィカフェ TOKYO
summary: The official Kirby café in Tokyo Solamachi at the foot of Skytree. Food and sweets look like Kirby and his friends.
why: Cute, funny food for game fans, and you can join it with the Skytree view.
cost: About ¥3,000–4,000 per person (estimate; check menu).
winterNote: Reservation needs an account (since Aug 2026 slots). Slots for a month opened on the 10th of the month before in 2026 (so Jan 2027 slots probably from about Dec 10, 2026, check). Max 3 bookings per month per shop; photo ID checked at the door. Open 10:00–22:00.

experience.hook: Eat a Kirby-shaped meal right under Tokyo Skytree.
moments: Find the café on Solamachi East Yard 4F, next to the Kirby Café The Store.
Order a Kirby dish and a dessert shaped like a Kirby character.
Photograph the food before you eat it; it looks too cute to cut.
Buy café-only goods at the store next door.
experience.tip: Come 10 minutes early with photo ID; the name on the booking must match.

title: Super Potato retro games and arcade
titleJa: スーパーポテト 秋葉原店
summary: A famous retro game shop on 3 floors with Famicom, Mega Drive and much more. The top floor is a small arcade with old cabinets and Japanese sweets (dagashi).
why: Old-school Japanese game culture next to the maid cafés; play a few ¥100 arcade games between cafés.
cost: Free to enter; arcade games from about ¥100; games and goods extra.
winterNote: Open every day 11:00–20:00. Kitabayashi Bldg 3F/4F/5F, next to the @home café main shop.

experience.hook: Walk into a shop packed floor to ceiling with Famicom cartridges.
moments: Go up to 3F and 4F, where the shelves are full of boxed retro games.
Look for old consoles, Famicom carts and rare handheld LSI games.
Play a round on an old arcade cabinet on 5F.
Buy a cheap dagashi sweet before you leave.
experience.tip: Check the back of the box for NTSC-J region before you buy a game to play at home.

title: Maid café night in Sapporo
titleJa: めいどりーみん 札幌狸小路店
summary: Maidreamin's 60-seat Sapporo shop on the covered Tanukikoji shopping street. Same maid show and spells as Akihabara, open until 23:00.
why: If you skip maid cafés in busy Tokyo, this is an easy, warm evening stop in snowy Sapporo.
cost: Entry ¥880 per hour + food/drink; about ¥1,500–3,500.
winterNote: Open daily 11:30–23:00. Tanukikoji is a covered arcade, so the walk is dry in snow. Sapporo Snow Festival 2027 dates: check (usually early Feb). Pin is Tanukikoji 4-chome (shop address: Minami 2-jo Nishi 4-10-2, Shimizu Bldg 6F).

experience.hook: Warm up from the Sapporo snow with a maid café spell.
moments: Walk the covered Tanukikoji arcade to the 4-chome block.
Take the lift to 6F of the Shimizu Building.
Chant 'moe moe kyun' over a hot drink with the maid.
Watch the stage show, then walk to Susukino for ramen.
experience.tip: Go after dinner; it is open to 23:00 and the evening shows are the liveliest.

title: Kansai temples, food and Uji
titleJa: 京都・大阪・奈良・宇治
summary: D6 Shinkansen to Kyoto, Fushimi Inari at dusk · D7 Kinkakuji + Arashiyama (early morning for snow) · D8 Uji: Hibike!
